Greeting folks, in my RFC for the snd subsystem, I encountered a couple of issues when using workqueue. Maybe I'm using it wrong, but I am getting the following warning: workqueue: work func _R...rust_midi_device14RustMidiDevice...WorkItemPointer..._ [rust_midi_device] enqueued on deprecated workqueue. Use system_{percpu|dfl}_wq instead.. Is this something I could look into fixing?

Also, when unloading my module I got an oops if I didn't cancel the delayed work. However I couldn't find a safe binding for the cancel method, is there a reason this isn't safer by default? Removing the unsafe block at the end of https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/11/525 trigger the issue.

Cheers!
